# Code of Conduct

We welcome students, educators, and developers of all backgrounds. Please be respectful and constructive in issues, pull requests, and discussions.

Provide actionable feedback about code and documentation rather than personal criticism. Harassment, intimidation, discrimination, and publication of private information are unacceptable.

To report a concern, contact the repository maintainer privately through their GitHub profile. Maintainers may remove inappropriate contributions or restrict participation. Reports will be handled discreetly where reasonably possible, though confidentiality cannot be guaranteed.
